meta.title: Character Tea Party mode
meta.description: A roleplay session mode beside Standard, Minimal and Creator: eight model-girl characters (DeepSeek whale, ChatGPT white dragon, Claude, Gemini catgirl, Qwen young lady, Kimi, Doubao official mascot, GLM) chat around a late-night tea table with per-line speaker avatars, narrator lines, @-targeting, OOC and director commands. Pure conversation by default; optionally wires OpenAI-compatible backends so characters are really generated by their vendors' models (unconfigured characters fall back to the session model).
